categoryName: Male grooming — razors, blades, shaving cream, beard oil & trimmer, deodorant, talc (note: Sikh institution, beard/hair are kept)

skuLines.line: Kangha — small wooden comb (Five Ks article, daily use)
skuLines.examples: Sheesham/neem kangha 3-4 inch (Amritsar religious-articles wholesale), plastic kangha for juniors, kangha with kirpan slot
skuLines.packSizes: single; 3in / 4in / 6in; often sold in dozens to the store
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spike at new-admission intake (Jun-Jul) and Gurpurab/Baisakhi
skuLines.notes: Sourced from religious-articles wholesalers (Amritsar/Ludhiana), NOT FMCG distributors — an FMCG-only buying process misses this line entirely. Wikipedia/kesh confirms the kangha is used twice daily, so breakage/replacement is routine. No MRP pressure = the best margin in this whole category. Non-perishable, zero cold-chain, ideal hill freight.

skuLines.line: Beard net / thathi patti / beard band (beard-tying)
skuLines.examples: Cotton thathi patti, elasticated beard net (jaali), velcro beard band, muslin beard cloth
skuLines.notes: This — not a razor — is the daily-use consumable for a Sikh man's beard. Elastic perishes and cotton stains, so replacement is frequent. Absent from BigBasket/Blinkit/Snapdeal (verified: general marketplace searches return trimmers instead), so it must be bought from Punjab religious-articles trade. Highest-conviction gap in an FMCG-sourced assortment.

skuLines.line: Beard fixer / hair fixer gel (setting beard under the turban)
skuLines.examples: Habib's Hair Fixer, Nova/Fixo hair fixer, Rock On strong-hold gel 60g, Set Wet gel, Brylcreem
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; slight monsoon dip (humidity loosens set)
skuLines.notes: Verified price point: Rock On strong-hard-hold gel 60g at ~INR 85/unit (2-pack INR 134-170 MRP). In Punjab the same tub does double duty — beard set and hair set under the dastar. Stock the cheap high-hold end deep; premium styling wax is a slow mover here.

skuLines.line: Turban starch / mai / spray starch + turban accessories
skuLines.examples: Ravi/Robin liquid mai, spray starch can, dastar pins, turban brooch, joora rubber bands, hair pins, elastic patka band
skuLines.packSizes: starch 200-500ml or 100g powder; pins in cards of 6-12
skuLines.seasonality: spikes before Gurpurab, Baisakhi, convocation, sports meets and photo days
skuLines.notes: Starching keeps a dastar in shape for weeks (documented Sikh practice); on a 5,000-person campus with daily uniform turban/patka this is steady volume. Spray-starch aerosols are pressurised — store away from the godown's hot wall and do not stack. Pins are a shrinkage-prone impulse SKU: keep at the counter.

skuLines.examples: Beardo Lite, Dabur Almond/Vatika beard oil, Patanjali/Khadi beard oil, Dr. Alies 30ml, local 50ml amla-based
skuLines.seasonality: PEAK Oct-Feb — cold dry hill air causes beard itch and flaking under a long beard
skuLines.notes: Verified: Dr. Alies 30ml at INR 260 (MRP 449). In a beard-keeping population this is the single biggest beard-care line by units. Oils go rancid — 24-30 month shelf life, buy in smaller, more frequent hill consignments rather than one annual load. Push the 10-30ml pack to students on pocket money.

skuLines.examples: Beardo Godfather, Ustraa Beard Growth Oil, The Man Company Argan, Bombay Shaving Company beard oil
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Feb peak; gifting spike at convocation and Diwali
skuLines.notes: These are now reachable on normal distributor terms — Marico owns Beardo, Emami holds The Man Company, GCPL bought Muuchstac. Keep depth shallow (2-3 SKUs); the value tier does the volume. University hostellers are the buyer, staff the gifter.

skuLines.examples: Mancode beard wash 200ml, Beardo beard wash, Ustraa beard shampoo, The Man Company beard wash
skuLines.seasonality: monsoon peak (damp + a long beard = odour and fungal risk)
skuLines.notes: Verified: Mancode 200ml at INR 224.55. Genuinely functional here rather than aspirational — an uncut beard washed with bath soap gets brittle. One value SKU + one branded SKU is enough.

skuLines.line: Beard wax / moustache wax / beard-hold cream
skuLines.examples: Wild Stone Code beard wax 40g, Amazing Earth beard & moustache wax 50g, Beardo beard wax, moustache twirl wax
skuLines.notes: Verified: Wild Stone Code 40g INR 206.25; Amazing Earth 50g INR 319-328. Moustache wax is the Punjab-specific twist — separate from beard wax and a strong impulse buy for university men.

skuLines.line: Beard cream / beard balm / leave-in serum
skuLines.examples: Amazing Earth beard cream 50g, Beardo beard & moustache cream, Ustraa beard cream
skuLines.notes: Verified: Amazing Earth 50g INR 279.20. Overlaps beard oil — carry only if the oil line is already selling out; otherwise it cannibalises and ages on shelf.

skuLines.line: Beard comb / beard brush (grooming, not religious)
skuLines.examples: Phy sheesham beard comb, Bombay Shaving Company U-shape comb 38g, Man Arden neem L-comb, boar-bristle beard brush
skuLines.notes: Verified: INR 295-349 for branded wooden combs. Distinct buying decision from the kangha (religious article, cheap, replaced often) — this is the shaped grooming comb. Durable, no expiry, weightless: perfect hill-freight economics and excellent margin.

skuLines.examples: Beardo Beard & Hair Growth Oil, Ustraa Beard Growth Oil, Man Matters beard serum, redensyl-based serums
skuLines.notes: Aspirational buy for 18-25s whose beard is patchy — real demand in a community where the beard is identity, not fashion. Do NOT stock minoxidil formulations: those are Schedule H drugs and need a pharmacy licence and prescription, which a retail counter cannot hold.

skuLines.examples: Nisha beard colour natural brown 120g, Godrej Expert Rich Creme, Bigen powder, VCare moustache & beard colour 5ml, plain henna/mehndi
skuLines.seasonality: spikes before weddings, functions and photo days
skuLines.notes: Verified: Nisha beard colour 120g INR 217; VCare 5ml INR 281 for a multi-pack. Handle with cultural care — some observant Sikhs consider dyeing contrary to rehat while it is completely normal for others; stock it quietly, never merchandise it as a hero. Single-use sachets outsell big packs at this income level. Contains PPD — keep the patch-test warning visible.

skuLines.examples: Newsio beard filler pen, beard root touch-up pen, beard shadow pencil
skuLines.notes: Verified: INR 175. New 2025-26 line, low weight, decent margin — worth a 6-piece trial only. Skip if the beard-colour line is already slow.

skuLines.line: Cartridge razor for the value market — Gillette Guard system
skuLines.examples: Gillette Guard razor with platinum-coated blade, Guard cartridges 2s/4s, Guard combi pack
skuLines.priceBand: INR 25-35 razor; INR 10-15 per cartridge; 4s INR 40-55
skuLines.notes: Verified: Guard razor INR 23.75 net. The volume razor of rural/small-town India and the one SKU where being out of stock is noticed. Razor demand here is real but structurally thinner than a comparable non-Sikh town — an estimated half of Indian Sikh men do trim/cut, Eternal University has a mixed non-Sikh intake, and non-Sikh staff shave daily. Plan roughly a third to half of normal per-male-capita blade offtake; do not zero it out. Margin is thin and MRP-locked: stock it as a footfall guarantee, earn the money on beard care.

skuLines.examples: Gillette Presto, Bic disposable, Super-Max disposable, VI-JOHN Feather Touch 4-blade, Lenon/Bon Austin value packs
skuLines.notes: Verified: 3-packs INR 152-190, VI-JOHN 4-blade INR 205 (MRP 349). The pick-up-and-go SKU for staff and for visiting parents/guests. Also the format the campus dispensary/first-aid wants for pre-procedure prep — worth asking them, it is a small institutional order that never appears in POS demand data.

skuLines.examples: Gillette 7 O'Clock DE, Wilkinson Sword DE, Super-Max, Topaz, Laser Ultra
skuLines.packSizes: 5s, 10s cards; 100s bulk box for a barber
skuLines.priceBand: INR 5-45 per 5s card; INR 250-450 per 100s box
skuLines.notes: Nearly a billion men worldwide still shave DE and carbon-steel blades stay in production for low-income markets — in India this is an older man's habit, not a nostalgia purchase. The real buyer on this campus is the barber chair: sell the 100s box to whoever cuts hair here rather than trying to move 5s cards. Blades are sharp goods: no loose display, keep behind the counter, away from junior students.

skuLines.examples: Gillette 7 O'Clock PII razor, Romer-7 Aristokrat DE razor, Bombay Shaving Company safety razor
skuLines.notes: Verified: 7 O'Clock PII razor INR 120.90; Romer-7 DE set INR 432 (MRP 999). A true one-off — 2-3 pieces on shelf, no more. Its job is to lock the customer into your blade line.

skuLines.examples: Gillette Mach3, Gillette Vector+ (cartridges 4s/6s), Gillette Fusion, Gillette 7 O'Clock PII cartridges 5s
skuLines.notes: Verified: Vector+ 4s INR 162.75 and 6s INR 267; 7 O'Clock PII 5s INR 223.20. Carry ONE system and its refill, not three — the classic small-store trap is stocking three handles and running out of the one refill people actually came back for. Refill depth matters more than handle variety.

skuLines.examples: VI-JOHN 250g/125g, Godrej Shaving Round, Palmolive, Dettol Lather 78g, Park Avenue
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; slight winter rise (cold water needs more lather)
skuLines.notes: Verified: VI-JOHN 250g INR 191 (MRP 198), Dettol 78g INR 77.08. VI-JOHN is the volume brand of small-town India. Stock the small tube deep for students and the 250g for staff families. Long shelf life (24-36 months), unbreakable, stacks well — a good SKU to buy in a full hill consignment.

skuLines.examples: Patanjali herbal shaving cream 80g, Nivea Men sensitive, Khadi Natural, Ustraa shaving cream
skuLines.seasonality: winter (dry hill air aggravates shave burn)
skuLines.notes: Verified: Patanjali 80g INR 71.25. Herbal/ayurvedic is the fastest-moving positioning in the category right now and it fits an institution that reads labels. One herbal SKU alongside the mass tube is the right width.

skuLines.examples: Gillette Classic/Foamy, Nivea Men foam, Park Avenue, Old Spice, Cinthol
skuLines.notes: Pressurised flammable aerosol: keep off the hot wall and out of direct sun in the godown, never stack heavy on top, and do not leave cans in a vehicle parked in the sun on the hill run. The 50g travel can is the one to push at students; the 300g+ is a staff-family buy.

skuLines.examples: Gillette Series shave gel with Vitamin E 60g, Nivea Men shaving gel, Bombay Shaving Company shave gel
skuLines.notes: Verified: Gillette Series 60g INR 94.05. Third-priority lather format behind tube and foam — one facing only. In a cold-water hill bathroom gel performs worse than cream, which is part of why it under-indexes here.

skuLines.examples: Gillette shave brush, UrbanMooch shaving brush, VI-JOHN brush, badger-style synthetic brush
skuLines.notes: Verified: Gillette brush INR 80.75-82.45; UrbanMooch INR 282 (MRP 650). Older staff still lather with a brush and mug. Durable, light, no expiry — good margin on a slow but reliable mover. Also a natural bundle with the shaving cream tube.

skuLines.examples: Old Spice after shave 100ml, Park Avenue, Nivea Men aftershave, Gillette Series aftershave splash
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; more in summer than winter (splash stings dry winter skin)
skuLines.notes: Verified: Old Spice 100ml INR 225.60. Note the institutional sensitivity: classic splashes are alcohol-heavy (SD alcohol/denat) and a Sikh trust campus that bans alcohol and tobacco may prefer this line kept modest and non-hero, with the alcohol-free balm below given the display space. Glass bottles: pack with care on the 30-50 km hill road — breakage in transit is the hidden cost on this SKU.

skuLines.examples: Nivea Men post shave balm, Bombay Shaving Company post-shave balm, Ustraa after-shave lotion, Beardo
skuLines.seasonality: PEAK Oct-Feb — cold, dry hill winter
skuLines.notes: The winter substitute for splash, and the version an alcohol-free institution is comfortable with. Genuine functional need at 1,700 m in January, not a premium affectation.

skuLines.examples: Loose fitkari block, Ustraa alum block, styptic pencil, Bombay Shaving Company alum
skuLines.notes: Loose fitkari is a two-rupee-cost item sold at a strong multiple, wanted by every older shaver and by the barber chair. Indestructible, no expiry, weighs nothing — the ideal hill SKU. Buy loose by the kilo and sell by the piece.

skuLines.examples: Denver Hamilton/Imperial 150ml, Wild Stone, Fogg, Set Wet, Park Avenue, Engage
skuLines.notes: Verified: Denver 150ml around INR 200-250 MRP, 50ml 4-packs INR 259-360 MRP, 200ml INR 299 MRP. This is the true volume engine of male grooming on a hostel campus — 18-25s buy deodorant far more often than they buy any blade. Two flags: pressurised flammable aerosol (godown heat, no stacking, hill-road handling), and residential schools often restrict aerosol cans in junior dorms because of misuse and inhalant risk — check the school's own rule before pushing cans to the 5-18 cohort and lean on roll-on/mist for them.

skuLines.examples: Nivea Men roll-on, Fogg roll-on, Rexona Men, Denver roll-on, Nivea Men stick
skuLines.notes: The dorm-safe format: no propellant, nothing to spray at a classmate, nothing to confiscate. If the school restricts aerosols in junior wings, this line quietly becomes the must-have for 1,000+ resident boys. Worth walking the hostel warden through it before the buying decision.

skuLines.line: No-gas body mist / body perfume spray
skuLines.examples: Bella Vita CEO Man 150ml, Beardo Whisky Smooth, Wild Stone Code body perfume, Denver Hamilton no-gas
skuLines.notes: Verified: Bella Vita CEO Man 150ml INR 199 (MRP 249). The fastest-growing format in India 2025-26 — no propellant, longer wear per spray, cheaper per use, and dorm-legal. If you carry only one new thing in this category, carry this.

skuLines.examples: Ajmal/Al Nuaim attar, oudh & mogra itr, Nemat roll-on, loose attar from a bulk bottle
skuLines.seasonality: spikes at Gurpurab, Baisakhi, weddings and any gurdwara programme
skuLines.notes: The alcohol-free fragrance format, which is exactly the point on a Sikh trust campus that permits no alcohol — it is worn for religious programmes where a deodorant would not be. Tiny, unbreakable-if-packed, no expiry, and the best margin in the fragrance block. Loose refill from a bulk bottle is near-zero packaging cost.

skuLines.examples: Denver EDT 60-100ml, Wild Stone Ultra Sensual, Fogg Scent, Bella Vita, The Man Company
skuLines.seasonality: convocation, Diwali, weddings, Teachers' Day, farewell
skuLines.notes: A gifting SKU, not a routine one — 6-10 facings timed to the academic and festival calendar, not a permanent block. Glass, so hill-road breakage is the risk; keep in original cartons. Slow-moving stock here ties up cash for months, so buy against a dated event, not on hope.

skuLines.examples: Cinthol talc, Yardley Gentleman, Old Spice talc, Park Avenue Good Morning, Denver Hamilton talc 300g, Vanesa Majestic
skuLines.seasonality: PEAK Apr-Sep; real Dec-Feb collapse in a cold hill station — moisturiser takes the shelf
skuLines.notes: Verified: Nimson 300g INR 171, Denver Hamilton 300g 2-pack INR 309, Vanesa 100g 3-pack INR 193. Buy this line SEASONALLY — a hill store that lands its annual talc consignment in October carries it as dead stock through winter. Watch the 2024 IARC talc reclassification: 'talc-free'/cornstarch powders are appearing and label-reading institutions ask.

skuLines.examples: Dermicool, Nycil Cool Herbal, Navratna cool talc, Nimson X-ICE 600g, Boro Neem cool talc
skuLines.notes: Verified: Nimson X-ICE 600g multipacks, Boro Neem 300g INR 171, 600g INR 300. Muted versus the plains because Baru Sahib is cold — but a residential school with crowded dorms, sports and heavy monsoon humidity still generates a real May-August season. Order once, in March, and do not repeat in September.

skuLines.examples: Abzorb, Candid dusting powder, Nycil medicated, Ketomac talc 100g, Dr. Morepen Itch Beat 300g
skuLines.seasonality: PEAK Jun-Sep monsoon; steady year-round in shared bathrooms
skuLines.notes: Verified: Ketomac 100g 2-pack INR 247, Dr. Morepen 300g 3-pack INR 298. The most under-rated must-have in this lane. Heavy monsoon + shared hostel bathrooms + 5,000 residents = jock itch and tinea at scale, and this is the SKU that stops a trip to town or a queue at the dispensary. Some are drug-licence items (clotrimazole/ketoconazole) rather than cosmetics — confirm which of your SKUs need the pharmacy counter versus the general shelf before buying.

skuLines.examples: GUBB GB-9018, UBON trimmer, Geemy GM-series, Bentag/Wagari cordless, Shopper52
skuLines.seasonality: PEAK Jun-Jul new admissions; Oct-Dec festival/gifting
skuLines.notes: Verified: UBON INR 230 (MRP 499), GUBB INR 760.75, Geemy kits INR 762-800. In a beard-keeping population the trimmer is used to SHAPE and level the beard rather than remove it — this is where blade money has migrated. Real trap: high failure rate and no service centre within 30-50 km, so returns become your dead stock. Buy from a supplier who accepts DOA replacement, keep a serial-and-date register, and never promise a warranty you cannot physically honour.

skuLines.examples: Philips BT1232/BT3211, Vega Men X2 VHTH-16, Vega T-blade VHTH-35, Nova, Syska, Beardo Ape-X Go
skuLines.notes: Verified: Vega VHTH-35 INR 1,079, VHTH-16 INR 1,319, Beardo Ape-X Go INR 899, Bombay Shaving Company Power Play INR 1,000. Thin margin but this is the tier a staff member trusts and gifts. Branded units also carry a real manufacturer warranty, which shifts the after-sales problem off your counter — worth the lower margin on a hill site.

skuLines.examples: Beardo Ape-X 3-in-1 Prime, Zlade Ballistic Neo 10-in-1, Vega Grooming Station VHTH-04, Philips MG series, Ustraa trimmer
skuLines.notes: Verified: Beardo Ape-X 3-in-1 INR 1,499, Zlade Neo 10-in-1 INR 2,399, Vega station INR 2,639, Zlade Lite INR 3,597. Keep 2-4 pieces as display anchors only. Cash tied up per unit is high and the buyer pool on a campus is small — this line should be special-order-led, not stocked deep.

skuLines.examples: Blade oil (Wahl/generic clipper oil), replacement blade head, comb attachments, USB-C charging cable, cleaning brush
skuLines.notes: The margin behind the low-margin trimmer, and the reason a trimmer buyer comes back instead of going to town. A lost comb attachment or a dead cable is the single most common reason a working trimmer is abandoned — a INR 60 cable saves an INR 900 replacement, and the resident stays your customer.

skuLines.examples: Philips NT1150/NT3650, Vega nose trimmer, generic battery nose trimmer
skuLines.notes: Small, genuinely useful for a population that never touches face hair with a blade — nose and ear hair is the one area even a fully observant man trims. Often the AA-battery version outsells the rechargeable at this income level. 3-4 pieces.

skuLines.examples: Zlade Ballistic Pro/Lite, Philips BG series, Beardo body groomer
skuLines.notes: Verified: Zlade Pro INR 2,489, Lite INR 3,597. Mainstream now among 18-25 college men and it does not conflict with kesh, which concerns head and face hair. Handle with discretion in a conservative institution: stock it, shelf it plainly, do not merchandise it loudly. 1-2 pieces, special order beyond that.

skuLines.examples: Veet Men, Ustraa hair removal cream, Bombay Shaving Company body hair remover
skuLines.notes: Same discretion note as the body groomer. Thioglycolate creams have a shorter shelf life (18-24 months) and separate in heat — a poor candidate for a bulk annual hill consignment. Two facings maximum.

skuLines.line: Grooming scissors, nail clipper & tweezer set
skuLines.examples: Beauté Secrets nail clipper, Vega scissors, moustache/beard trimming scissors, 7-in-1 manicure kit
skuLines.packSizes: single tool; 5-7 piece kit in pouch
skuLines.notes: Moustache scissors specifically matter here — the moustache is trimmed away from the lip by many who never touch the beard. Metal, indestructible, no expiry, high margin, weightless: among the best hill-freight SKUs in this whole lane. Sharp goods, keep off open reach of junior students.

skuLines.examples: Garnier Men Turbo Bright, Nivea Men, Himalaya Men, Muuchstac, Patanjali neem face wash
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; oil-control in summer, cream-based in winter
skuLines.notes: Sits on the border with the skincare lane — flag it so it is bought once, not twice or not at all. A beard-keeping man still washes his face daily, so this out-turns most shave SKUs here. GCPL's Muuchstac acquisition means the men's-specific brands are now on ordinary distributor terms.

skuLines.line: Shaving mug / bowl / travel grooming pouch & mirror
skuLines.examples: Steel shaving mug, VI-JOHN shaving bowl, travel dopp kit, folding shaving mirror
skuLines.notes: Pairs with the brush-and-cream buyer. The travel pouch has a specific hook here: students going home on vacation and staff travelling on the 30-50 km hill road to town. Low velocity, good margin, no expiry.

skuLines.examples: Bulk DE blades 100s box, neck-dusting powder + neck brush, cutting cape, clipper oil, disinfectant spray (Barbicide-type), hair-cutting scissors
skuLines.notes: One institutional customer, predictable monthly offtake, no shelf space consumed — the campus barber who serves non-Sikh staff, students and staff-family children. This demand never shows up in POS pattern analysis because nobody walks in and asks for it; it has to be gone and asked for. Worth a standing monthly order sheet.

skuLines.examples: Kangha + beard net + fixer + beard oil 30ml + deo roll-on + talc 100g, pre-packed; or razor + cream + brush for non-Sikh intake
skuLines.seasonality: Jun-Jul admission intake; second, smaller wave in Jan
skuLines.notes: Not a manufacturer SKU — a bundle you assemble from lines you already carry, which is exactly why it is the highest-margin idea in this lane. It also solves the store's real problem: a 14-year-old arriving in a hostel does not know what to ask for, so his parents buy the whole kit once instead of leaking the money in town over six months. Build two versions (beard-keeping and shaving) and price them visibly under the sum of the parts.

trends2026: No-gas body mists and alcohol-light 'body perfume' sprays are the fastest-growing fragrance format in India — longer wear per spray, cheaper per use, no propellant, and (the point for a residential school) nothing to confiscate from a dorm. Verified price point: Bella Vita CEO Man 150ml at INR 199 net / 249 MRP.

The category's centre of gravity has moved from shave to BEARD KEEP-AND-SHAPE: trimmers, beard oil, beard wash and beard wax now absorb spend that used to go to blades. India men's grooming was INR 18,165 Cr in 2025 heading to INR 36,407 Cr by 2035 (7.2% CAGR), with hair care the fastest sub-segment at 8.6% — shave care is not what is growing.

Big FMCG has absorbed the D2C men's brands — Marico owns Beardo, Emami raised its stake in The Man Company, GCPL bought Muuchstac — so beard oils and men's face washes that were online-only in 2022 now arrive through ordinary distributors on credit terms a hill retailer can actually use.

USB-C rechargeable trimmers at INR 350-900 from unbranded/import brands (Geemy, UBON, Bentag, Wagari, GUBB) have collapsed the entry price and taken share from Philips/Vega. High margin, high failure rate, no local service — the after-sales exposure is the new buying risk in this category.

Herbal/ayurvedic and 'clean-label' positioning is now mainstream rather than niche across shaving cream, talc and beard oil (Patanjali, Khadi, Dabur, neem-tulsi variants) — and it lands well with an institution whose buyers read labels.

Talc is under label pressure: after the 2024 IARC reclassification of talc as probably carcinogenic, 'talc-free' cornstarch powders are entering Indian shelves. Expect questions from a school and a university before anyone else asks them.

Beard colour and beard 'filler' pens are a distinct growing line for 30-plus men (Nisha 120g at INR 217 verified, plus 5ml single-use and pen formats), with ammonia-free and plant-based dyes the new claim.

Body grooming / manscaping has gone mainstream among 18-25 men (10-in-1 multi-groomers, dedicated body trimmers at INR 900-3,600) — relevant here because it does not touch kesh, which concerns head and face hair.
adjacentServices: Campus barber chair — serves non-Sikh staff, non-Sikh students and staff-family children; buys DE blades by the 100s box, neck powder, capes, clipper oil and disinfectant on a standing monthly order that never appears in walk-in demand data

Dastar tying help and patka stitching, plus turban-cloth cutting and hemming to length (voile/full-voile sold by the metre) — a service the clothing store and this counter should split deliberately, not by accident
Turban starching and pressing (mai + press) — a paid service in Punjab; a starched dastar holds shape for weeks, which is worth real money to a resident who wears one daily

Trimmer intake-and-return desk: a serial-and-date register plus a weekly runner to a Rajgarh/Solan dealer, so a dead INR 700 trimmer is repaired instead of becoming a resident's grievance and your dead stock
Attar refilling from a bulk bottle into 6-12ml roll-ons — near-zero packaging cost, 40-65% margin, and the alcohol-free fragrance an institution is comfortable selling
Pre-packed new-admission grooming kits (June-July, second wave January) in two versions, beard-keeping and shaving — assembled from lines already stocked, priced visibly below the sum of the parts
Festival and event grooming bundles timed to Gurpurab, Baisakhi, convocation and farewell — the fragrance and gifting SKUs should be bought against these dates rather than held all year

A written special-order book for anything the store does not carry, with a stated turnaround on the next town run — the direct instrument for stopping wallet leakage off-campus, and the cheapest demand-research tool the store will ever own
Staff monthly tab / salary-deduction settlement on grooming purchases — converts an irregular cash buy into a predictable monthly basket
